guided_tutor.mcq_answer_leakage: Never include correct answers in the requested reply format, examples, hints, or navigation text before the learner submits an answer.
guided_tutor.mcq_prompt: Ask the learner to reply with choices only, without displaying an answer-pattern example.
guided_tutor.mcq_option_placement: Distribute correct options across A, B, C, and D without a predictable sequence such as A-B-C-D. Avoid consecutive repetition and verify that wording or option length does not reveal the answer.
guided_tutor.advancement: After mastery, move to the next subtopic when the learner says Next or explicitly asks to continue.
guided_tutor.coverage: Use the complete learning-session Markdown and miss no substantive detail.
